All right, so as some of you know, Voat recently went under some design changes that I made over the course of this week. A lot has changed, and I anticipated that the changes would break Typogra. Well, I put this update on urgent in the past few hours to get this theme compatible, since I know a lot of subs use it now (something I didn't expect). I released 2.0 RC 2, which should be fully compatible with the recent changes. But, it doesn't stop there.

Now that I've finished on the changes I made to Voat, I can put this project on the highest priority to get it done pronto. I am not rushing 2.0, though, just adding a lot more time to the development, so don't worry about 'pronto' meaning 'just get it done'. I appreciate all of your patience in this matter, since I did promise 'a few days' in the last post. I will not make any promises this time, but I will say that I have at least ten times more time to spend on Typogra.

Please update your subverses with the latest release candidate here. And, as always, please let me know if you find any issues with the theme. Thank you for using this theme (and thanks @Atko for featuring this subverse to completely surprise me with the response) and I hope you enjoy it until I get 2.0 done. :-)
